claim: The one adversarial review of the harness kit (2026-11-25, the owner's ruling r58-0020): one Opus refuter in a fresh context, given none of the builders' conclusions and told to list only breaking faults it could show by a run or by the code path and the input that reaches it; 9.10 M tokens, 61 messages, about 14 minutes. It showed two. F1: the window ceiling gave an Opus session or helper no line on a machine without the owner's model settings, because the fallback table of windows held Fable and Sonnet only, while the README, rule K7 and five coverage rows said such sessions were held; the clean-clone check could not see it because it runs under the owner's home settings. F2: under a cap a helper killed by an app restart keeps its unused limit reserved in the fan-out gate until it is ended by hand, and nothing in the kit named the command, so a later start was refused with no way out given. It found sound, each by runs: the Rust programs against their JavaScript hooks on real transcripts of this repository (fan-out gate 250 of 250, creep gate 150 of 150, window ceiling 612 of 612 calls with the same exit and text); the set-up applied, applied again, for a second project, and removed, with a person's own settings entries byte-identical afterwards; unit.mjs on a passing landing, a failing check, a conflict, two landings at once and a lander killed between its merge and its record. It could not settle whether the usage tool's answer on another plan has an all-models window. Four notes it classed as not breaking were left as they are. One Opus builder repaired both faults in the JavaScript hooks and the Rust programs (3.70 M, 58 messages, about 10 minutes; commit 54b17300): Opus gets 400 K in the fallback table (the window this project measured under, r57-0107), and in kit mode the two gates print the command that ends a dead helper with the machine's own paths. Test files after the repair, both ways: window-ceiling 135, fanout-gate 49, count-gate 28 with 2 skipped. The clean-clone check, run once more after the repair, passed every line and exited 0. No second review. The job's total at 19:29 UTC: 95.62 M of the 100 M cap, of which the coordinating session 20.14 M over 69 messages (21 %).
